name: Farhanul Islam
title: SQA
tagline: I build fast, accessible and thoughtfully designed web applications.
about: I'm a developer who enjoys turning complex problems into simple, elegant interfaces. I care about clean architecture, performance and the small details that make a product feel good to use.

Over the past few years I've shipped production apps end to end — from database schema and REST APIs to pixel-polished frontends. When I'm not coding, I'm reading, learning a new tool, or contributing to open source.
